visuals.formula: Premium = offer price ÷ unaffected share price − 1

visuals.title: Quiz
visuals.text: Five questions. Answer along on the cards below the transcript, then hear Marco's answers.

quiz.pause_at: Pause here if you want to think it through

questions.q: Delta's unaffected share price is €20. After a bid letter leaks it trades at €24, and Atlas offers €25. What's the premium?
questions.explain: €25 ÷ €20 − 1 = 25%. The €24 price already contains the bid, so measuring from it, Sofia's slip, understates the premium.
questions.explain_at: The premium is measured against the unaffected price

questions.q: Under the UK Takeover Code, which of these can't a target board do once a bid is coming, without shareholder approval?

options.text: Refuse the offer and publish its reasons
Look for a rival bidder, a white knight
Issue lots of new shares to block it

questions.explain: Issuing shares to block a bid is frustrating action, which needs shareholder approval. Arguing, promising more cash and seeking a white knight are all allowed.
questions.explain_at: the board can't take action that would frustrate it

questions.q: Who did Arcelor turn to as its white knight against Mittal Steel?
questions.explain: Arcelor agreed on 26 May 2006 to merge with Severstal, controlled by Alexei Mordashov. Dofasco was the Canadian business it put in a Dutch trust, so Mittal couldn't sell it to ThyssenKrupp.
questions.explain_at: A white knight, in the jargon

questions.q: During a bid, the target's shares trade above the offer price. What is the market telling you?

options.text: The offer price is too high
The deal will probably be blocked

questions.explain: Nobody pays more than the offer for a share unless they expect a better one, from the bidder or a rival. Reading it as 'the offer is too high' was Sofia's guess.
questions.explain_at: If the shares trade above the offer, investors are betting on a higher bid

questions.q: Red Cat needs acceptances for 50% plus one of Steyr Motors' shares. Roughly how much has it secured through irrevocable undertakings?
questions.explain: The anchor shareholder, B&C Holding Österreich, has irrevocably undertaken to tender its stake of about 15%. Roughly another 35% has to come from everyone else.
questions.explain_at: has signed an irrevocable undertaking to tender its stake of about fifteen percent
